reason: Plural shape deployment (#504 part 1, milestone 2a): module-size 28266->28319 (+53). Measured on this tree rebased onto dd9345a, from scratch on both sides with each branch's own allowance moved aside -- not carried forward from the ca89ca2 round and not derived arithmetically. Only the base moved; the contribution is the same +53 measured in the previous round, and main's 28266 cross-checks exactly against the value #682 recorded. The printed line reads 26965 -> 28319 (+1354), but baselines.json is stale (2026-08-10) and 1301 of that is inherited from main's own allowed growth (#674, #684, #675, #682). The +53 is entirely ts/src/core/migrator.ts (+77/-24) and it is the feature: threading the `shapes` union that #586 detected but left unread through collectOverlaySkills, deploySkills, installWorkflows and checkFreshness, so a monorepo deploys for every shape it has instead of the `deploy_to: [all]` residue an `unknown` scalar yields. Two things the growth is NOT: the signature change itself (shape: string -> shapes: string[] on four methods) is net zero lines, and the 43 call sites moved to the array signature are all in ts/test/migrator.test.ts, which module-size does not count -- verified empirically by reverting the test file to main's version and re-measuring, which left the number unchanged. What the +53 actually buys, in order of size: 36 of the 77 added lines are doc comments stating the new contract (shape is a set; an empty set is the old `unknown`; one pass is what keeps the deploy manifest read and written exactly once; `--check` must resolve the same set `migrate` deploys or it reports in sync about skills it never examined), roughly 10 lines are the new FreshnessReport.shapes field with its constructor parameter and to_dict entry, roughly 9 are the plural `Shapes checked:` markdown block and the multi-shape abstention wording, roughly 5 are the deployShapes union re-derived from the effective scalar so a --framework override joins the union, and the remainder is prettier rewrapping three call sites and one predicate that no longer fit on one line. This rebase carried a real conflict with #682 in installWorkflows: both gates were kept, since they ask independent questions (#667's `withheld` asks whether a skill's templates are ours to place at all, the shape set asks which of its variants this repo wants). No file needed splitting and nothing was absorbed here to avoid a fix: zero new architecture violations, and complexity did not regress -- migrator.ts's pre-existing cyclomaticComplexity violations are untouched by this change and were not ratcheted.
